welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.content: Let's take a quick tour to get you started.

input.title: Start a conversation
input.content: Type your question and press Enter. On the first line, press Up to reuse an earlier prompt; Down moves forward and Esc restores your draft.

inputMenu.title: Add to your chat
inputMenu.content: Use + to attach files, add Knowledge or Tools, choose an Agent, or open the Workspace.

model.title: Model
model.content: Select which AI model powers your conversation.

record.title: Input actions
record.content: Use the microphone to dictate, the book to browse prompts, or the context indicator to check usage.

chatHistory.title: Chat History
chatHistory.content: Continue, favorite, edit, or delete past conversations.

search.title: Search
search.content: Quickly find previous chats from your chat history.

takeTour.title: Take a tour
takeTour.content: Replay this walkthrough anytime from the menu under your name.
